notes: Communist relates to communal/collective group orientation.
Woke relates to social justice/anti-oppression; problematic is broad moral disapproval.
Hippie suggests peace; militaristic suggests war, group allegiance, and hierarchy.
Gluttonous/moderate relates to temperance and bodily self-discipline.
Manners concern respect/proper conduct; good/bad gives broad evaluation.
Creationist pole relates to religious/spiritual belief.
